purpose: Strenger Evidence-Contract und Projektionsvalidierung fuer BodyTwin [C1], verifiziert durch W23-W34

rules: R1 top-level keys restricted to fixed allowlist; unknown key => E_ALLOWLIST_TOP
R2 nested objects restricted to per-class allowlists; unknown nested key => E_ALLOWLIST_AGG
R3 enums case-sensitive: evidence_class, mode, status, channel => E_ENUM / E_ENUM_CASESENSITIVE
R4 required fields: evidence_class, mode, status, channel, units, created => E_REQUIRED
R5 all numeric values finite (NaN/Infinity rejected) => E_FINITE
R6 time ordering: capture_ts <= fetch_ts => E_TIMEORDER
R7 status VERIFIED requires source identity with kind PERMITTED_READBACK => E_SOURCE
R8 age_basis rules per status (AGGREGATE_ONLY: aggregate_window required; UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN: no claims)
R9 source ids must not match PRIVATE_PATTERN => E_PRIVATE
R10 class/mode consistency: E1_HISTORICAL_AGGREGATE requires mode HISTORICAL; E2_SYNTHETIC_DERIVED requires SYNTHETIC; E3_PUBLIC_SAFE_PROJECTION allows HISTORICAL or LIVE
R11 status consistency: AGGREGATE_ONLY only with E1_HISTORICAL_AGGREGATE
R12 units must be a declared SI-compatible unit string per channel

binding_for_r46_5: Only records with status VERIFIED and source identity PERMITTED_READBACK may enter fusion as measured data.
AGGREGATE_ONLY records (R21 parent aggregates) are descriptor-level only; ceiling C1_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY applies.
E2_SYNTHETIC_DERIVED must never be labelled VERIFIED.
Records failing any rule are rejected at ingest; no repair path in R46-5.
ABSTAIN is an allowed, first-class outcome and must be propagated, not dropped.
